name: Penciller ☆ Kana
source:
Eroge company Ripe is the stage. Main character becomes a new worker here. While working overnight, once a fairy from the other world appears before the hero. He gets transformed into a cute girl. His co-workers accept the change in appearance and give him a new name "Penciller ☆ Kana". So begins extraordinary life in the game company.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事舞台是成人游戏公司Ripe，主人公成为了这里的新员工。某次通宵工作时，一位来自异世界的妖精出现在他面前，并把他变成了可爱的女孩。同事们接受了他外貌上的变化，还为他取了一个新名字——“Penciller☆Kana”。游戏公司的非凡生活就此开始。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
